correctness.rationale: For a property of a successful attempt ending at z, summation over the number of earlier failures multiplies its one-attempt mass and the one-attempt z mass by the same geometric factor. On an allowed k-step path, the independent reset clock contributes exp(−r sum W_j), so the conditional rescaled waits have independent transform (1+a)/[(1+s)^β+a] and the path has mass (h/2)^k, h=a/(1+a). The unique shortest path has m steps. Summing the crude 2^k word bound from k=m+2 shows that all other strata have conditional mass O(a²). The transform of a unit-rate Gamma(jβ) law is (1+s)^(−jβ); geometric expansion of the tilted transform gives a signed measure series absolutely convergent in total variation for a<1. Subtracting the unit-rate Gamma(β) term and a times Gamma(β) minus Gamma(2β) leaves norm O(a²). Finite tensor multiplication preserves this order, and pushing forward to simplex shares contracts the variation norm. Under the base law normalization gives Dirichlet_m(β); replacing one shape β by 2β multiplies its simplex density by A_(m,β) v_j^β. The resulting correction has integral zero and is nonconstant by comparing the barycenter (sum m^(1−β)) with a vertex limit (sum 1); full interior support then gives half the absolute integral as a strictly positive distance coefficient. At β=1 the exact common-rate exponential tilt gives uniform Dirichlet shares, so only the off-m mass contributes. The one opposite step in a word of length m+2 must occur before the mth toward step, at any of m positions except the first if that opposite step would reach the other absorber. The remaining paths start at m+4, giving c h²/4+O(h⁴) and the stated expansion in 1/(rτ). This verifies fixed m≥2 and each specified endpoint, without uniformity in β or interval length. The source verifier and VERIFICATION.md were inspected; the recorded 2804 comparisons are finite supplements, not replayed here or used to prove the asymptotics.

value.rationale: The observable removes the arbitrary scale of excursion time and asks whether anomalous trapping still leaves a signature when short successful paths overwhelmingly dominate. The strictly positive coefficient answers yes and distinguishes intrinsic clock distortion from the rare change in path length that is the entire memoryless error. This is meaningful information absent from splitting probabilities and total-time statistics.
